summary: An agent's natural first invocation must reach a useful outcome: missing API key surfaces an actionable auth error (not a buried Google 403 with exit 0), non-English-only videos auto-fall back to the sole available caption track when --lang is defaulted, transcripts render as markdown/text without hand-rolled converters, and the conventional names (top-level `search`, --limit) resolve.
reason: Dogfood session 2026-07-06: search never succeeded because the raw 403 was buried per-term with exit 0; the transcript command hard-failed on an Italian-only video until manually retried with --lang it, after which the user hand-rolled a JSON-to-markdown converter; `search` and --limit were both guessed first and dead-ended.
validated_outcome: No-key search exits 4 with the remediation hint; it-only video EX0Kz0SpqFs transcribes with default flags (fallback noted on stderr) and renders --format markdown/text; a second default-lang run serves from cache — normal rows with zero requests, fallback alias rows after a single track-list revalidation that upgrades to requested-language captions published later (and degrades to the cache offline); explicit --lang en still exits 5 and never accepts the alias row; --limit and top-level `search` work. The `search` alias is mcp:hidden so the MCP tool surface is unchanged.
